title: Earth Day Poster
description: A promotional poster for Earth Fest 2011 at the Oak Park Public Works Center, built around a tree illustration and the event details.
content: A promotional poster I designed for Earth Fest 2011, a community event at the Oak Park Public Works Center. Green and beige palette with a tree illustration, laid out around the key event details — date, location, activities, and the Billion Acts of Green tie-in.
